payload.outcome: Both halves closed, in different ways. The FIRST defect (the scan refuses 'lead' with no notion of a job title, so raw identifiers pass while the correct plain-words label fails) was already closed by Ruling [143] on 2026-08-27, which put the three-alternative narrowing into tests/helpers/caring-contacts-prohibited-language.ts: 'the clinical programme lead' now passes alongside clinicalProgrammeLead, so the scan no longer rewards leaving developer wording on a clinical screen. The SECOND and larger defect is closed by this change: src/lib/caring-contacts/** is now a third scan root in tests/caring-contacts-interface-vocabulary.test.ts, so the sealed domain's wording constants (STOP_REASON_WORDING and APPROVAL_ROLE_WORDING, CARING_CONTACT_ROLE_WORDING, PATHWAY_APPROVAL_ROLE_WORDING, PLAN_ASSURANCE_WORDING, message-copy.ts) are read by a prohibited-language check for the first time. Two exemptions, both held against rot by their own tests: message-rules.ts whole, as the definition site of the rule doing the scanning, and reach-reporting.ts's no-safe-disclosure discriminant by exact string. The literal table is pinned as not-an-ignore-list: a different offending string in the same file still fails. Verified by mutation, not only by a green run.
